New _frozen4_sets; INFO cascade_gain vs _frozen and _frozen4, g_gap for composed / _frozen / _frozen4 (incl. affine scale / shear / QR rotation), INFO deform_extra (composed / frozen / frozen4 / identity for neg_jac_pct, inv_consistency_mm, ncc_template, ncc_pair), S_rel_diff_vs_level2 printed when present. Grad-balance INFO label: 'KEEP current balance (deform64)' when config.json args.task_grad_norm == 0, else 'KEEP task-grad-norm'. Module docstring.

Header comments: measured facts (section 7), A100 rule (-p dgx-a100 only if smoke peak <= 36 GiB), grad-balance KEEP/FALLBACK rule, prefetch rule (data-wait > 0.10 -> PREFETCH=2), MaxRSS > 56 GB -> --mem 96G, time formulas, the smoke / long / A100 submit lines, resume plan, 'DO NOT submit without Jay's approval; account qtim only', cluster order (pull -> smoke -> long).
